name: Recon Cockpit
description: An on-demand reconnaissance cockpit for authorized web security research. Passive discovery, a bounded same-origin crawl, parameter extraction with reflection/open-redirect/CORS testing, JWT decoding, and evidence-backed checks for exposed configs, secrets, and VCS metadata. Nothing runs until you start it.
